text:
maria: FYI enterprise customer (Acme Pay) opened a ticket — retention update via API failed. They set custom_retention_days=30 but objects still show TTL=365 and deletes aren't happening. Audit logs show KMS errors 'AccessDenied'. Can someone triage?

kevin: Linking ticket + quick repro I ran: https://support.redwood.com/ticket/56821 — can pick this up.

ops-bot: Alert: retention-change-failure detected for project=acme-pay, incident_id=ret-2026-03-16-01.

maria: Repro steps from customer: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/projects/acme-pay/retention 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
 -d '{"custom_retention_days":30}'
```
Response: 403 with body: `{"error":"kms:AccessDenied","message":"unable to update encryption key policy"}`

jordan: Can you paste the exact error blob from our audit log (request_id + key_id)? That will speed root cause.

sophie: Any legal hold or preservation order on this account? retention overrides might be blocked by hold.

maria: Customer says no active legal hold. They did previously request a historical export but didn't request a hold. They also called Delete API earlier and got 202 but objects still enumerable in list API.

kevin: I reproduced in staging. Error looks like service principal didn't have kms:Decrypt/kms:DisableKeyRotation for the customer key used by their org. Found in logs: 
```
{"time":"2026-03-16T22:14:02Z","request_id":"abc123","error":"AccessDenied","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999:key/0a1b2c3d"}
```
Workaround: run retention update from Console (uses infra service role) or add decrypt permission to key policy. I'll prepare a minimal key policy change.

luis: This is urgent for our compliance team — can you give an ETA to get retention set to 30d and confirm deletions will start?

legal: If customer requests expedited purge we need written consent + confirmation of scope. I'll draft the POA/consent template and send to maria to share.

sophie: We should export full audit trail for the attempted update (user, ip, request_id, key_id) and preserve it. @kevin can you attach the export to the ticket?

kevin: Uploading export to ticket now: /s/logs/56821/retention_kms_export.ndjson. Key findings: two failed KMS decrypts (request_id=abc123, def456) at 2026-03-16T22:14Z and 22:17Z. Suggestion: grant `arn:aws:iam::service-role:redwood-infra` kms:Decrypt on the key or re-run via Console.

maria: Action items: (1) kevin update key policy + attach logs to ticket, (2) sophie confirm no hold + preserve export, (3) legal send POA template if customer wants purge, (4) i'll update customer with a 48h ETA and interim workaround (console path).

kevin: I'll push a targeted policy change to staging for review and then prod after approval.

maria: Noted, sending update to Acme Pay now. :thumbsup:
